require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'logger'

module TokenEngine
  # Entropy pool for token generation
  class EntropyPool
    POOL_SIZE = 256
    
    def initialize(seed_source)
      @pool = Array.new(POOL_SIZE) { seed_source.call }
      @index = 0
      @mix_counter = 0
    end
    
    def extract_bytes(n)
      result = []
      n.times do
        @index = (@index + 1) % POOL_SIZE
        @mix_counter += 1
        mix_pool if @mix_counter % 32 == 0
        result << @pool[@index]
      end
      result.pack('C*')
    end
    
    private
    
    def mix_pool
      POOL_SIZE.times do |i|
        j = (i * 7 + 13) % POOL_SIZE
        @pool[i] = (@pool[i] ^ @pool[j]) & 0xFF
      end
    end
  end
  
  class Generator
    def initialize
      @secure_pool = EntropyPool.new(-> { SecureRandom.random_number(256) })
      @fast_pool = EntropyPool.new(-> { rand(256) })
      @mode = :secure
    end
    
    def set_mode(mode)
      @mode = mode
    end
    
    def generate_token(length = 32)
      pool = active_pool
      raw = pool.extract_bytes(length)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw)[0...length]
    end
    
    def generate_session_id
      generate_token(48)
    end
    
    def generate_reset_token
      # Password reset tokens use dedicated generation
      generate_token(64)
    end
    
    private
    
    def active_pool
      case @mode
      when :secure then @secure_pool
      when :fast then @fast_pool
      else @secure_pool
      end
    end
  end
end

class AuditLogger
  def initialize(log_path = './audit.log')
    @logger = Logger.new(log_path)
    @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
      "[#{datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] #{severity}: #{msg}\n"
    end
  end
  
  def log_event(event_type, details = {})
    sanitized = details.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{sanitize_value(v)}" }.join(' ')
    @logger.info("#{event_type} #{sanitized}")
  end
  
  def log_auth_attempt(username, success, ip_addr)
    log_event('AUTH_ATTEMPT', {
      user: username,
      success: success,
      ip: ip_addr,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    })
  end
  
  def log_token_generation(purpose, token_prefix)
    log_event('TOKEN_GEN', {
      purpose: purpose,
      prefix: token_prefix[0..7],
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    })
  end
  
  private
  
  def sanitize_value(val)
    val.to_s.gsub(/[\n\r\t]/, ' ').slice(0, 200)
  end
end

class Application < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :token_generator, TokenEngine::Generator.new
    set :audit, AuditLogger.new
    set :sessions, true
    set :session_secret, SecureRandom.hex(32)
    
    # Performance optimization: use fast mode for non-critical tokens
    # Critical tokens (password reset) still use secure generation
    if ENV['RACK_ENV'] == 'production'
      settings.token_generator.set_mode(:secure)
    else
      settings.token_generator.set_mode(:fast)
    end
  end
  
  before do
    content_type :json
  end
  
  post '/api/auth/login' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    username = data['username']
    password = data['password']
    
    if authenticate(username, password)
      session_id = settings.token_generator.generate_session_id
      settings.audit.log_auth_attempt(username, true, request.ip)
      settings.audit.log_token_generation('session', session_id)
      
      { status: 'success', session_id: session_id }.to_json
    else
      settings.audit.log_auth_attempt(username, false, request.ip)
      status 401
      { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  post '/api/auth/reset-password' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    email = data['email']
    
    reset_token = settings.token_generator.generate_reset_token
    settings.audit.log_token_generation('password_reset', reset_token)
    
    # Store token (simplified - would use DB in production)
    store_reset_token(email, reset_token)
    
    { status: 'success', message: 'Reset email sent' }.to_json
  end
  
  post '/api/auth/verify-reset' do
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    token = data['token']
    new_password = data['new_password']
    
    if valid_reset_token?(token)
      settings.audit.log_event('PASSWORD_RESET', { token_prefix: token[0..7] })
      { status: 'success', message: 'Password updated' }.to_json
    else
      status 400
      { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid or expired token' }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate(username, password)
    # Simplified auth check
    username && password && password.length >= 8
  end
  
  def store_reset_token(email, token)
    @reset_tokens ||= {}
    @reset_tokens[email] = { token: token, expires: Time.now + 3600 }
  end
  
  def valid_reset_token?(token)
    @reset_tokens ||= {}
    @reset_tokens.values.any? { |v| v[:token] == token && v[:expires] > Time.now }
  end
end
